items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Leonard Feather had hired Big Sid Catlett and I to do a record date... Leonard and I we didn't speak anymore from then on.

ctx.x: I stand to be corrected. Yeah, so Monty Kaye and I say our group, we was fighting for dear life, you know, busting chairs over heads and things, turning over tables, throwing the chairs in the whiskey. Boy that was a blow out.

So Leonard and I we didn't speak anymore from then on. Cause all of the, like they had a thing in the Downbeat, the Three Deuces. He and George Simon and Barry Ulanov (Phonetic). They reviewed all records and the star ratings, you know, how many.
